steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: In October 1918, Germany was facing defeat in World War I. The Kaiser's government transformed into a parliamentary democracy to secure better peace terms. However, the revolution went further than intended when sailors mutinied at Kiel on 3 November 1918. | Key Fact: The Weimar Constitution, approved on 11 August 1919, created the most democratic system Germany had ever known - but it contained crucial weaknesses that opponents exploited. | Key Fact: Friedrich Ebert, leader of the SPD, became the first President of the Weimar Republic in February 1919. steps.body: Describe two weaknesses of the Weimar Constitution. (4 marks) | Explain why the Spartacist Uprising failed. (8 marks) | How far was the Weimar Republic threatened by right-wing opposition in the years 1919-1923? (12 marks)
